title: Gold Thief
desc: Bhavani Prasad, a gold appraiser, learns of his grandfather's secret from years ago. As a result, he decides to help him set things right but faces many challenges in his quest.

title: Mubarakan
desc: Identical twin brothers turn to their eccentric uncle for help to make sure that they each marry the woman they love.

title: Adipursh
desc: Raghava, prince of Ayodhya, begins an epic journey with his brother Shesh and allies to rescue Janaki after the fearsome king of Lanka abducts her.

title: Drunken Master
desc: Wong, a playful boy, learns martial arts from a drunk master. He trains hard to stop a deadly assassin and protect those he cares about.

title: Godse
desc: Terror spreads when Godse takes prominent leaders hostage. A determined police officer investigates the shocking motive behind the ruthless operation, uncovering secrets that shake the nation.

title: Savyasachi
desc: Vikram has alien hand syndrome. He falls in love with Chitra, but his life changes when his brother-in-law is killed and his niece is kidnapped. He must save her.

title: MLA Ka Power
desc: Kalyan falls in love with Indu. In order to prove his love for Indu, Kalyan has to become an MLA and only if he succeeds, he gets to marry her.

title: Valeba Raja
desc: Karthik tells Shalu about his past love for Sweety, giving him 15 days to decide on their wedding. Tensions rise when Sweety unexpectedly reappears, complicating his decision.

title: Marriage Bureau
desc: A money-minded marriage broker, Malligadu runs a bureau, arranging marriages with a one-year relationship guarantee, challenging love, ethics, and trust as couples' fates intertwine.
